title: Hilary and Jean Simmons to Caleb Glasgow,1 August 1761,Letter Book 1 pp. 40–41

citations.name: Caleb Glasgow
citations.type: Hilary and Jean Simmons to Caleb Glasgow,1 August 1761,Letter Book 1 pp. 40–41
citations.place: Currituck County, North Carolina, United States
citations.assertion: Candidate identity of the single recorded purchaser Caleb; compatible account Glasgow-830 retained, not two purchasers.. Caleb bought approximately 50 acres of swamp for£4 proclamation money, part of Simmons’s 20 May 1761 patent. FullDauge-corner boundary matches William’s 1782 sale. Acknowledged at the firstTuesday January 1762 court. No father/child role stated. Caleb Glasgow: Candidate identity of the single recorded purchaser Caleb; compatible account Glasgow-830 retained, not two purchasers.; Caleb Glasgow: Compatible alternative account of the same Caleb purchaser; no separate second conveyance or distinct-person conclusion. Reviewed 2026-10-31; Original image receipts in tmp/currituck-357-originals-20261031; raw scans preserved privately, not published.
